passage.text: Sorry I haven't written for so long.
passage.reading: ˈsɑːri aɪ ˈhævənt ˈrɪtən fər soʊ ˈlɔːŋ.

passage.text: I've been working at the refugee camp near the border for six weeks now, and the days are very long.
passage.reading: aɪv bɪn ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ət ðə ˌrɛfjuˈdʒiː ˌkæmp ˈnɪr ðə ˈbɔːrdər fər ˈsɪks ˈwiːks ˈnaʊ, ənd ðə ˈdeɪz ər ˈvɛri ˈlɔːŋ.

passage.text: Thousands of people live here, and many of them have lived in the camp for years.
passage.reading: ˈθaʊzəndz əv ˈpiːpəl ˈlɪv ˈhɪr, ənd ˈmɛni əv ðɛm hæv ˈlɪvd ɪn ðə ˈkæmp fər ˈjɪrz.

passage.text: Most families live in small wooden shelters with plastic roofs.
passage.reading: ˈmoʊst ˈfæməliz ˈlɪv ɪn ˈsmɔːl ˈwʊdən ˈʃɛltərz wɪð ˈplæstɪk ˈruːfs.

passage.text: The weather is harsh: it's very hot during the day, and in the rainy season, the paths become rivers of mud.
passage.reading: ðə ˈwɛðər ɪz ˈhɑːrʃ: ɪts ˈvɛri ˈhɑːt ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə ˈdeɪ, ənd ɪn ðə ˈreɪni ˌsiːzən, ðə ˈpæθs bɪˈkʌm ˈrɪvərz əv ˈmʌd.

passage.text: I work as a nurse at the camp's health center.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈwɜːrk əz ə ˈnɜːrs ət ðə ˈkæmps ˈhɛlθ ˌsɛntər.

passage.text: Yesterday, I met an old woman who had walked for nine days to get here.
passage.reading: ˈjɛstərdeɪ, aɪ ˈmɛt ən ˈoʊld ˈwʊmən huː hæd ˈwɔːkt fər ˈnaɪn ˈdeɪz tə ˈɡɛt ˈhɪr.

passage.text: She is a survivor, and she is so strong.
passage.reading: ʃiː ɪz ə sərˈvaɪvər, ənd ʃiː ɪz soʊ ˈstrɔːŋ.

passage.text: But sometimes I feel helpless, because I can't solve people's real problems.
passage.reading: bʌt ˈsʌmtaɪmz aɪ ˈfiːl ˈhɛlpləs, bɪˈkɔːz aɪ ˈkænt ˈsɑːlv ˈpiːpəlz ˈriːəl ˈprɑːbləmz.

passage.text: Then a child smiles at me, or someone says thank you, and I remember why I came.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn ə ˈtʃaɪld ˈsmaɪlz ət miː, ɔːr ˈsʌmwʌn ˈsɛz ˈθæŋk juː, ənd aɪ rɪˈmɛmbər ˈwaɪ aɪ ˈkeɪm.

passage.text: Can I ask for your help?
passage.reading: kən aɪ ˈæsk fər jʊr ˈhɛlp?

passage.text: The children here need books in English.
passage.reading: ðə ˈtʃɪldrən ˈhɪr ˈniːd ˈbʊks ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ.

passage.text: Could you ask your friends at the university for some old books?
passage.reading: kʊd juː ˈæsk jʊr ˈfrɛndz ət ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti fər sʌm ˈoʊld ˈbʊks?
